description: Fixed OHLC vectors for the CRAN bidask 2.1.5 AR (sign = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) equality check. Floats are Python float.hex() strings (exact); null = NaN/NA (missing). windows: [first, last] = 0-based indices of the later bar of the pair products (ar_window convention); rolling_width: also run spread(width = w).

cases.name: 03_missing_bar_all_nan
cases.note: test_ar_missing_bar_breaks_pair: no valid pair -> R NaN, ref None

cases.name: 12_negative_window_mean_multi
cases.note: rising staircase, close near the high, next mid-range above it: window mean clearly negative (one positive pair inside); sign=TRUE returns -sqrt(|mean|)

cases.name: 13_high_equals_low
cases.note: high == low on every bar (close off the range); also mean of log-range 0

cases.name: 14_high_equals_low_equals_close
cases.note: high == low == close on varying bars: every pair product 0

cases.name: 15_nan_gaps
cases.note: 60 bars with runs of missing bars (5-7, 20, 33-34, 58)

cases.name: 16_partial_nan_close_only
cases.note: bar 1 has high/low but close NaN: R and the transcription keep pair (0,1) (uses c0, eta0, eta1); luna.v7.spread drops the whole bar

cases.name: 17_partial_nan_high_only
cases.note: bar 2 high NaN: both pairs touching eta2 are NaN in every implementation

cases.name: 18_random_walk_2000
cases.note: seeded (424242) random-walk OHLC, 15 sub-steps per bar, 4 bp half-spread bounce; rolling width 96 (= 95 pairs, the S-4.5 24 h window at tau = close of the last bar + 1 min)

cases.name: 19_random_walk_2000_gappy
cases.note: case 18 with every 37th bar missing; rolling width 96
